verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.kommo.com (HTTP 200, structured API documentation index) and markdown versions of the docs whose frontmatter has an agentTools projectIndex pointing back to llms.txt. The marketing site also serves its own llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
